name: Re;world episode2
source:
The day after the Ark Invasion.
The future was lost, and with it Mikage's hopes.

"I don't want to fight any more. I can't bear to see any more death."

He fought with the others and fled to start a solo resistance.
Just when things were at their bleakest, an unknown voice spoke to him.
"I see. Venus sent you."

Lured by Sera's trickery he descended into hell,
shrouded in the darkness of her deceit.
At last the true mastermind revealed himself:
the god Jupiter. What does he want? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE107461.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
方舟入侵后的第二天。
未来失去了，御影的希望也随之消失。

“我不想再战斗了，我不忍心看到更多的死亡。”

他与其他人战斗并逃跑，开始单独抵抗。
就在一切最黯淡的时候，一个陌生的声音对他说话。
“我明白了。是维纳斯派你来的。”

因色拉的诡计而堕入地狱，
笼罩在她欺骗的黑暗之中。
真正的主谋终于现身了：
朱庇特神。他想要什么？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE107461.html]DLsite English[/url]]
